arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Goldstein argued the case involves an ERISA pension plan. He stated the retirees accrued full pensions. He noted they took early retirement at age 39.
Mr. Gossett argued the fund promised specific job rights. He claimed the retirees accepted early retirement packages. He stated they should work without sacrificing pensions.
Mr. Elwood argued the IRS approved similar plan amendments. He stated the IRS allowed these amendments for existing benefits. He claimed this practice lasted for at least twenty years.
